2026_02_MIA_SF.headline: Miami’s protection and tempo face a 49ers defense returning home with momentum
2026_02_MIA_SF.paragraph1: Miami remained in Northern California after its opener, reducing another cross-country travel hit before facing San Francisco. The Dolphins are without Chop Robinson and Ronnie Harrison, while the 49ers ruled out receiver De'Zhaun Stribling and listed Kaelon Black questionable. Miami needs efficient early downs and protection that keeps its passing game on time; San Francisco can control the matchup by creating pressure, limiting yards after catch and making the Dolphins repeatedly convert long third downs.
2026_02_MIA_SF.model_rationale: Miami’s ability to stay on schedule against San Francisco’s pressure and tackling, plus the 49ers’ capacity to sustain offense despite receiver attrition, are the key efficiency questions.
